PRE_FLIGHT_FINDING (banked to lessons.md as 🟤 decision):
              🟤 React 19's @types/react@19.2.14 made ReactPortal.children REQUIRED (was optional in React 18 types). This propagates through `type ReactNode = ... | ReactPortal | ...` and breaks every consumer that returns a ReactNode union member — including Radix UI ForwardRef components (which return ReactPortal in their type chain) and Next.js App Router async page/layout functions (which return Promise<ReactNode>). Module augmentation in apps/web/src/types/react-19-portal-fix.d.ts widens children back to optional; pnpm.overrides ensures consistent @types/react@19.2.14 across the monorepo. Removal trigger: delete the .d.ts when @radix-ui/* and Next.js generated types catch up to React 19's stricter ReactPortal — verify with `pnpm --filter @orqafy/web typecheck` after deletion.
